workflow: Groups run in array order; tasks run in array order within their group unless dependsOn says otherwise.

Completed work is removed from this file - done through the easy-sweep (2026-07-11): G00-G05, G08, G09, G10 (on-GitHub verification of workflows still pending the remote), superuser bootstrap, and the /users/me slice; every verification lives in the git checkpoint commits. Group ARRAY ORDER = execution order.
One task = one working session. Set status=in_progress before starting; set done only when the endGoal is observed, not assumed.
Never start a task whose dependsOn are not all done.
After the last task of a group: run the group's checkpoint, fix any fallout, then `git commit -m "checkpoint(<groupId>): <group title>"`.
Tips are guidance, not prescriptions - decide from context; PLAN.md wins over any tip; record resolutions by appending to the task's tips.
Any task that adds an Env field updates config/env.py AND .env.example in the same task.
From G03 onward ruff+mypy must be green at every checkpoint; GitHub CI is expectedly broken until G10 rewrites it (no remote exists yet) - local checkpoints are the gate.

groups.title: Admin: unfold + framework
groups.rationale: Needs the User model and auth to exist; lands before the test group so the admin-basics gate has a real admin to run against.
groups.checkpoint: Admin themed by unfold; users admin fully works (list/search/filter/edit/export) with explicit can_* permissions; generate_dashboard scaffolds a valid package; superuser bootstrap is repeatable; commit.

groups.title: Inner depth: users API + tests + gates
groups.rationale: The in-depth inside work (user decision: outside-in): mount+verify the /me exemplar endpoint, then the test suite and the cross-app gates that protect everything.
groups.checkpoint: uv run pytest green including both gates; coverage >= 80%; uv run lint-imports green; uv run mypy strict green repo-wide; commit.

groups.title: Docs
groups.rationale: Documenting last means documenting reality, not intent.
groups.checkpoint: A newcomer can bootstrap from README alone; ARCHITECTURE.md matches the implemented tree; every Env field appears in .env.example; commit.

groups.title: Final verification
groups.rationale: PLAN.md's 7 verification steps as the closing sweep.
groups.checkpoint: All three verify tasks done; final commit marks the transformation complete.

groups.title: Deferred items + user reviews (deliberately last)
groups.rationale: User decisions (2026-07-11): investigations, not-sure items, and social-login integration must NOT block the build - implementation proceeds on PLAN defaults; deferred/review work happens at the end. Review outcomes may change code: re-run affected group checkpoints and the G12 sweep afterwards.
groups.checkpoint: Every review task done with decisions recorded in tips; any resulting changes re-verified (affected checkpoints + G12 sweep); final commit.
